title: Revolutionary
body:
I have tried so many productivity tools throughout the years. Both apps and of the analogue variety. But I always run into the same problem. My own brain. Organizing my own thoughts just enough to actually do the thing, instead of just thinking about the thing, has been a major problem for me all my life. Goblin Tools gives me at least a chance of doing the things that I want to do. Instead of me just having a neat idea, swirling formless and diffuse. It even estimates a timeframe for each task. I know I will spend the double, but it is nice to have a timeframe all the same. 

I just write the task that I wish to accomplish, and it gives me easy steps to follow. How small and easy those steps are, can be adjusted. And each one of those steps can be broken down into even smaller steps if need be. It does all this by the tap of a button!  I can also choose how many layers of the to-do list is visible so that I only have to focus on one part at a time. 

To the developers: Thank you from the bottom of my heart. And thank you for not making this into a subscription thing. You should have a tip jar in the app, so that anyone who wants to support you, can. I know I would.
